$comment: Banned-term data for the just-say-so matcher. `words` and `phrases` are hard violations. `patterns` are raw regexes (hard). `contextual` entries carry a condition a matcher cannot judge (e.g. 'unless quantified'), so they report as advisories and never block on their own.

words.hint: use a concrete verb: use, apply, rely on

patterns.regex: \b(?:it|this|that|he|she|they|we)(?:'s|'re| is| are| was| were)(?: actually)? not (?:just |only |merely |simply )?[^.,;:!?\n]{1,80}?[,;:—–]\s*(?:it|this|that|he|she|they|we)(?:'s|'re| is| are| was| were)\b
patterns.label: "it's not {x}, it's {y}" frame
